items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: I was telling Dick the other day... I never had five people too different, Dick.

ctx.x: Your name is Hall, my wife. Sometimes it changes. Yeah, chances of greening the Hall. Well everybody in the band had nicknames. We talked about it. All we asked was you, man. Yeah.
I was telling Dick the other day, I don't know if you remember what the office nickname was. Shook. Shook, yeah. You didn't remember that?
